presets.name: Plain
presets.description: Several eyes and mouths carry printed color: red hearts, a blue tear, a pink tongue. Dropping those leaves the black and white drawing on a single field, which is the style at its cleanest. It also makes every color preset below a one-color change.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The style has one color group, so a monochrome set is one field plus the exclusions Plain explains.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Four greys, no hue at all.
presets.description: The drawing is already black and white once the colored expressions are out, so this only asks the ground to follow.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One teal field for every avatar.
presets.description: A single ground across a whole set. Only the pair of eyes and the mouth separates two avatars, which for this style is the whole identity anyway.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The six colors the style ships are all fully saturated, which is a lot of shouting when a page shows twenty of them. These carry the same drawing without the volume. The colored expressions come out too, the same ones Plain drops: a red heart is the loudest thing on the page next to these.

presets.name: Electric
presets.summary: Six fields past the shipped set.
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever. The features are solid black, so they hold up against anything behind them.

presets.name: Cool
presets.description: Half the color wheel, and the counterpart to Warm. Useful when two groups of avatars need telling apart at a glance.

presets.name: Warm
presets.description: The other half of the same wheel.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.summary: Dark fields, features that survive them.
presets.description: The features are solid black and cannot be recolored, so on a dark ground only the expressions with light in them still read: glasses, shades, a mask, a row of teeth. Everything else would disappear, so this preset leaves it out.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient across the tile.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.description: The field fills the tile either way, so nothing is lost by cropping. What changes is the size of the two things that carry the expression.
